title: Fix integrations page 404 and remaining hydration regressions
description: Why: The live deployment still shows broken custom-built functionality after recent fixes. The integrations page requests /api/integrations/ and gets 404, React throws minified hydration error #418 on pm.mahakalp.dev, and the editor logs duplicate extension names for embedComponent. What: Identify the root causes, fix the broken integrations flow and remaining hydration mismatch, remove duplicate editor extension registration if applicable, and redeploy. How discovered: Observed from live browser console while testing the custom-built functionality on pm.mahakalp.dev after label fixes were deployed.
close_reason: Fixed in commit 702b3cff9 and pushed to preview

title: Audit custom-built functionality regressions

title: Fix broken project sidebar translation keys

title: Epic: Platform foundations for Pro/Business parity
description:
Why:
Current fork needs shared primitives so feature teams do not re-implement flags, permissions, audit, and jobs inconsistently.

What to build:
- Workspace-scoped feature-flag framework with backend enforcement.
- Permission matrix hardening for new modules.
- Event/audit primitive for critical actions.
- Reliable background job primitives (idempotency + retry + visibility).

How discovered:
Planning for Pro/Business parity showed repeated dependencies across all planned modules.
acceptance_criteria: DoD: foundational APIs/UI/test harness exist and at least one existing feature is migrated to each primitive.

acceptance_criteria: DoD: Turning a flag off blocks protected API with deterministic 403 code; turning on enables flow without restart; API/UI tests pass.

title: Implement Forgejo issue import logic
description:
## Why
Need backend logic to handle importing issues from Forgejo repositories into Plane projects.

## What
Create import handler similar to GitHub import:
- Fetch issues from Forgejo API
- Map Forgejo labels to Plane labels
- Map Forgejo users to Plane users
- Create issues in Plane with proper state mapping
- Handle comments and attachments

## How discovered
Reviewed existing importer patterns in codebase.

title: Create Forgejo frontend service
description:
## Why
Need a service on the frontend to interact with Forgejo integration API endpoints.

## What
Create apps/web/core/services/integrations/forgejo.service.ts:
- listAllRepositories(workspaceSlug, integrationSlug)
- getForgejoRepoInfo(workspaceSlug, params)
- createForgejoServiceImport(workspaceSlug, data)

Following pattern from github.service.ts

## How discovered
Reviewed existing github.service.ts implementation.

title: Add Forgejo TypeScript types
description:
## Why
Need TypeScript types for Forgejo integration on the frontend, following the existing GitHub types pattern.

## What
Create packages/types/src/importer/forgejo-importer.ts:
- IForgejoServiceImportFormData
- IForgejoRepoCollaborator
- IForgejoRepoInfo

Similar structure to github-importer.ts

## How discovered
Following existing types pattern in the codebase.

title: Create Forgejo integration database models
description:
## Why
Need database models to store Forgejo repository connections and sync state, similar to existing GitHub models.

## What
Create new models in apps/api/plane/db/models/integration/forgejo.py:
- ForgejoRepository: Store repo metadata (name, owner, url, repository_id)
- ForgejoRepositorySync: Link repos to Plane projects with sync config
- ForgejoIssueSync: Track synced issues
- ForgejoCommentSync: Track synced comments

## How discovered
Following existing pattern from github.py models.

title: Add Forgejo to importer model choices

title: Add Forgejo VCS Provider Integration
description:
## Why
Plane currently only supports GitHub as a VCS provider for importing and syncing issues. Many self-hosted teams use Forgejo (a Gitea fork) for their git hosting needs.

## What
Implement full Forgejo integration including:
- Import issues from Forgejo repositories
- Repository linking and sync capabilities
- OAuth and API token authentication
- Two-way issue/comment sync

## How discovered
Researched Forgejo API documentation and compared with existing GitHub implementation in this codebase.

title: Create Forgejo API endpoints for repository and issue operations
description:
## Why
Need backend API endpoints to interact with Forgejo instances for importing and syncing issues.

## What
Create API endpoints similar to GitHub:
- GET /workspaces/{slug}/workspace-integrations/{id}/forgejo-repositories - List available repos
- GET /workspaces/{slug}/importers/forgejo/ - Get repo info (issues, labels, collaborators)
- POST /workspaces/{slug}/projects/importers/forgejo/ - Create import from Forgejo
- POST/PATCH/DELETE for repository sync management

Forgejo API uses: Authorization: token {api_token}

## How discovered
Researched Forgejo API documentation at forgejo.org/docs
